messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH - inference-runtime-prod - kv_cache.eviction_rate > 1000 (5m) - 23 hosts affected. Paging @maya (oncall). Link: https://monitoring.redwood.internal/alerts/1987654321

maya (oncall): acked. seeing ~1200 evict/s on a subset of pods, latency not yet impacted but pages are loud. tagging eng-oncall.

ashwin: thanks. quick check — any recent rollout to inference-runtime?

maya (oncall): not that I know of. small model upgrade yesterday but traffic pattern steady.

carl: looking at logs, majority of evictions are from a background prefetch job on a minority of clients, looks benign: message contains "prefetch_eviction"

ashwin: if it's prefetch-related we should suppress the alert until we confirm impact. propose a temporary threshold bump to 5000 evict/s for 30m and add a suppression rule excluding prefetch logs.

maya (oncall): +1 on temporary lift. please post the exact query change so I can push emergency rule.

ashwin: proposed alert query (current):
```
metric:kv_cache.eviction_rate > 1000 for 5m
filter: service:inference-runtime AND env:prod
```
proposed temporary (emergency):
```
metric:kv_cache.eviction_rate > 5000 for 10m
filter: service:inference-runtime AND env:prod
```
and add log-based suppression: exclude events where message matches /prefetch_eviction/

carl: diving into raw logs, example lines:
```
[2026-03-15T09:12:01Z] pod=inf-rl-17 message="kv_cache: prefetch_eviction triggered for key=abc123 duration=2ms"
[2026-03-15T09:12:02Z] pod=inf-rl-18 message="kv_cache: eviction due to oom_candidate for key=xyz987"
```
We should keep signature for oom-related evictions but suppress prefetch ones.

eva: I can deploy a regex signature update in alerts repo. Suggest adding negative match to the alert rule: `AND NOT message:/prefetch_eviction/` and add new signature `oom-eviction` for clearer triage.

maya (oncall): please mark timeframe and update oncall runbook once suppression in place. If latency or errors rise, revert immediately.

ashwin: creating temporary suppression now. Patch snippet I'm about to apply: 
```yaml
alert: kv-cache-eviction-spike
expr: kv_cache.eviction_rate > 5000
for: 10m
labels:
  severity: warning
annotations:
  summary: "kv cache eviction spike (temporary threshold)"
filter: service:inference-runtime AND env:prod AND NOT message:/prefetch_eviction/
```
I'll open a PR for permanent signature change.

sre-runbook-bot: note added -> incident 1987654321: temporary threshold increased + suppression for /prefetch_eviction/ (30m).

maya (oncall): suppression applied, noise reduced. moving to monitoring mode. can we add a small dashboard tile to track oom-eviction vs prefetch_eviction counts over next 6 hours?

carl: creating a quick dashboard: two series: count(message:/prefetch_eviction/) and count(message:/oom_candidate/). link: https://dashboards.redwood.internal/d/kv-evict-1987

eva: reopening runbook entry for kv-cache: added section for "prefetch vs oom" signatures, instructions to add regex excludes and how to revert threshold change.

ashwin: action items: 1) promote regex signature to main alerts repo PR #472, 2) schedule postmortem check-in with model infra to root-cause prefetch surge, 3) keep suppression for 3 hours then reassess.

maya (oncall): assigning follow-ups: ashwin -> PR; carl -> dashboard; eva -> runbook update; maya -> customer impact check (paging suppressed but good to confirm no user-facing errors).

ashwin: PR created: https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/pulls/472 - includes regex, new oom signature, and test cases.

maya (oncall): excellent. marking incident status: mitigated -> monitored. will handoff to next oncall at shift change and include note about the emergency threshold bump.

sre-runbook-bot: handoff scheduled to @next-oncall at 1987657200.

maya (oncall): thanks everyone. closing thread once PR merges and dashboard shows stable ratios for 2 hours. :thumbsup:
action_items: ashwin: open PR to promote regex exclusion for prefetch_eviction and add oom-eviction signature (#472)
carl: create and share ephemeral dashboard tracking prefetch_eviction vs oom_candidate counts (link posted)
eva: update oncall runbook section for kv cache signatures and suppression playbook
maya: monitor customer-facing metrics for 2 hours and perform handoff to next-oncall
